rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when praising something as impressively good.

example.jyutping: ni1 deoi6 bo1 tek3 dak1 zan1 hai6 sai1 lei6

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when the surprising quality is an extreme or unbelievable degree.

example.english: It's amazing that you ate the whole plate by yourself.
example.traditional: 你一個人食晒成盤菜，真係誇張。
example.jyutping: nei5 jat1 go3 jan4 sik6 saai3 seng4 pun4 coi3 zan1 hai6 kwaa1 zoeng1

rows.note: Use this for a wondrous or almost magical kind of surprise.

example.english: This phone can work all day without charging; it's amazing.
example.traditional: 呢部手機唔使充電都可以用成日，真係神奇。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 m4 sai2 cung1 din6 dou1 ho2 ji5 jung6 seng4 jat6 zan1 hai6 san4 kei4
